Three directions, one set of screens

Each row is one screen of version 0.2, shown three ways at phone width. A is version 0.2 as it was built: the Instrument look with its blue accent and the system font. B is the same page with the V2 tokens exactly as Figma holds them today, and C is the same page with the V2 tokens on this branch, which add 77 contrast fixes and 22 proposed tokens to what Figma holds; both B and C use Geist.

B and C keep version 0.2's layout and parts. A bridge stylesheet points 0.2's colour, type, spacing, radius and size settings at the nearest V2 tokens (v2/screens/bridge-map.json says why for each), so they show V2's values on 0.2's parts, not V2's own components. The line under each frame was measured at 375 pixels wide in the theme shown.

Of the V2 values the bridge uses, only one differs between B and C: --color-text-secondary in light (#6b6e76 in B, #505258 in C). Everything else on these screens is the same in B and C, and in dark they are identical; the other contrast fixes change tokens the bridge does not use.
